speaker: Speaker A
text: Welcome everyone! Today we need to choose a database for the project.

speaker: Speaker B
text: Our data is structured. Meetings own segments, and segments belong to meetings.

speaker: Speaker A
text: That points to a relational database. I think we should go with PostgreSQL for this.

speaker: Speaker B
text: I agree. PostgreSQL gives us strong consistency and great tooling.

speaker: Speaker A
text: Good. Next topic is deployment. Let's do Docker so every environment is consistent.

speaker: Speaker B
text: Agreed! Docker keeps our setup simple.

speaker: Speaker A
text: Great. We will review the frontend design next week.
